history.detail: Patch release for #491 / #493 -- applications linking to mlx-swift would crash on launch on macOS/iOS earlier than 26.4 (SDK issue).
Use release 0.32.3 -- important patch for #491
Fixes build issue on iOS.
For SwiftPM users, the swift-tools-version changes to 6.3.  There are no changes in SDK requirements, but this may require a newer Xcode to build.
